Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires are on the field. Bangladesh are all set to defend and the fielders have taken their respective positions on the field. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Ruturaj Gaikwad will open the batting innings. Ripon Mondol has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The bowling from India was spot on as they picked up wickets at regular intervals. With just 4 overs from the pacers, it was Sai Kishore who was the pick of the bowlers as he scalped 3 wickets while Washington Sundar picked a couple. While Tilak Varma, Shahbaz Ahmed, Arshdeep Singh, and Ravi Bishnoi took a wicket each. The target isn't a big one but with the purchase on offer for the spinners could Bangladesh make a game out of it or will the star-studded Indian batting side make an easy chase of this low total? Let's find out with the run chase in a while.

Bangladesh were off to a sluggish start with 21 for 3 in the powerplay as Mahmudul Hasan Joy, Saif Hassan and Zakir Hasan all departed without any significant contributions. It was Parvez Hossain Emon who showed some fighting spirit but departed soon on 23. Wickets kept tumbling on a regular intervals with Bangladesh stranded for runs. A solid counter-attacking innings right at the end from Rakibul Hasan and Jaker Ali helped Bangladesh score 96 on board.

An excellent bowling performance from the Indian bowlers have restricted the Bangla batters to a low total in the first Semi-final. We are at the halfway stage of this game with Bangladesh scoring just 96 runs in their quota of 20 overs.

Ripon Mondol tries to pull it away but with no control and timing as he sends the ball straight up in the air. Rinku Singh at mid-wicket completed a good catch. A good bowling performance by the Indians.

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks break. India has started off strong and put Bangladesh on the back foot here in this match. A few quick wickets have increased the pressure on the batters and helped India to be a little more aggressive in their bowling. They should look for some more wickets and clean Bangladesh up for a low score. Bangladesh on the other hand needs to preserve wickets and score runs at the same time. Partnerships will be very crucial and a few good ones wouldn't hurt their cause.

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities and we are all set for the match to commence. The umpires are on the field. The Indian players are walking out on the ground and have taken their respective positions. Mahmudul Hasan Joy and Parvez Hossain Emon will open the batting innings for Bangladesh. Arshdeep Singh has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...
The players from both teams are out on the field along with the match officials for the national anthems. It will be the national anthem of Bangladesh first followed by the Indian national anthem.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Jaker Ali, Mrittunjoy Chowdhury, Parvez Hossain Emon, Zakir Hasan, Rakibul Hasan, Saif Hassan (C), Shahadat Hossain, Hasan Murad, Mahmudul Hasan Joy, Ripon Mondol, Afif Hossain.
India (Playing XI) - Ruturaj Gaikwad (C), Yashasvi Jaiswal, Tilak Varma, Jitesh Sharma (WK), Rinku Singh, Shivam Dube, Washington Sundar, Shahbaz Ahmed, Ravi Bishnoi, Sai Kishore, Arshdeep Singh.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of India. They have elected to BOWL first.

UPDATE - 6.19 am IST (12.49 am GMT) The news from the center is that the toss is delayed a bit owing to some light rainfall earlier. The rain has stopped now and the covers are off too. Hopefully, we hear some good news soon enough, Stick with us for further updates.

Bangladesh also had a very close victory against Malaysia the other day winning by a margin of 2 runs. They too are playing with the second-string squad but these young guys have played some very good cricket in this tournament. Saif Hassan is leading the team and setting an example scoring as many runs as he can with the bat. Their top order looks out of form and they will hope to bounce back in this match as the stakes are high. Afif Hossain and Ripon Mondol bowled some good spells in their last match with Hossain managing to give away only 2 runs in the last over. This team has a tough competition to face in this match and it will certainly be a treat to watch the clash. The winner will fix their spot in the big finals and fight to take the Gold medal home. The stakes are high and it will be a high-octane encounter. Stay with us as live action will take center stage shortly. We will bring you the toss and team updates soon.

India is the clear favourites for this match and they have proved their salt after clinching a good victory against Nepal. Yashasvi Jaiswal had a very good day with the bat as he scored a century in just 49 balls. The skipper, Ruturaj Gaikwad had a good start but couldn't take the innings deep but the explosive cameo by Rinku Singh and Shivam Dube at the end gave their bowling unit a good score to defend. Their relatively less experienced bowling unit leaked a lot of runs but compensated for that by taking timely wickets. Ravi Bishnoi was the most economical bowler as he got 3 wickets in the bag along with Avesh Khan. This is the second-string squad of India with the main team playing the World Cup but these guys have all the experience needed to perform on the big stage and also carry a lot of expectations on their shoulders. They will want to win this semi-final and live up to those expectations.

Hello and a very warm welcome folks. The Asia Cup 2023 is about to end, and we are awaiting the 1st semi-finals for the Men's Cricket event. India will go up against Bangladesh in this match at Hangzhou.
... MATCH DAY ...

The Asian Games are in full swing and we are now nearing the end of the Men's Cricket Competition. India will be taking on Bangladesh in the first semifinal at the ZJUT Cricket Stadium in Hangzhou. India are making their maiden appearance in the Cricket Competition at the Asian Games and the Women's team has already clinched Gold whereas Bangladesh have been in the medal places on previous occasions. India started their campaign in a quarterfinal clash against a strong Nepal side and were made to work a bit in the field. India, who are fielding a second-string side just like Bangladesh do have a lot of individual talent thanks to the Indian T20 League. Yashasvi Jaiswal struck a stellar ton in their previous game with the likes of Shivam Dube and Rinku Singh showing their prowess toward the end of the innings. With the ball, Avesh Khan and Ravi Bishnoi were among the wickets but both received a bit of tap as well. Bangladesh on the other hand had a real scare in their quarterfinal against Malaysia but managed to hold on and win the contest by just 2 runs. They put on a meager total on the board with the top three only managing to add 1 run to the total. The middle order got crucial runs but the bowlers were the star of the victory. Ripon Mondol was fantastic up top and then Afif Hossain rolled his arm over as a part-timer and picked up three crucial wickets. India do look primed for a Gold medal but will be aware of the fact that Bangladesh will come at them hard. Will we see an upset? Or will the favorites zoom through to the Gold medal match? We shall find out.
